description: React component for the enterprise edition left panel in Mattermost admin console, handling license display, updates, and related UI interactions.

methods.name: EnterpriseEditionLeftPanel
methods.description: Main React component rendering the enterprise edition license panel, handling license info, updates, and UI interactions.

methods.name: renderLicenseContent
methods.description: Renders the license details section, including license info, add/remove license buttons.

methods.name: renderLicenseValues
methods.description: Helper to render individual license detail rows with special handling for expiration, active users, and guest limits.

methods.name: renderAddNewLicenseButton
methods.description: Renders button and input for adding a new license.

methods.name: renderRemoveButton
methods.description: Renders the remove license button with dynamic label based on state.
